svg.title: 2 PhysZSSM: physically stepped slice context
svg.desc: A bidirectional, spacing-aware selective state-space scan over z tokens at each in-plane location.

g.aria-label: Bidirectional selective scan over z tokens; no down-sampling along the slice axis
Each (h,w) cell is scanned independently; forward and backward parameters are not shared.
Padded slices keep the residual $x$; only the scan update and $\Delta_t$ are masked.
